title: Rebuild my three outfit looks from their Meshy bodies and my own head
why: Every look is my own face, lips and face jewellery on an outfit body Meshy built from the photographs, with that look's own hair. When my head, my rig or the assembler changes, all looks must be rebuilt the same way so they stay consistent.

steps.title: Put my head on the copper-rose coat body
steps.why: My head on the v3 coat rig, placed automatically from the neck and Head bones; the generated hairline and sideburns in front of my ears are cut.

steps.title: Put my head on the copper catsuit body
Put my head on the Home/Laidback 3 body
Build the coat's hairstyle from its photograph
steps.why: Meshy's hair cannot make real curls; this removes it and grows ~400 helical curl locks from my scalp, swept back to the waist, with the flower-of-life medallion.

steps.title: Build the catsuit's hairstyle from its photographs
steps.why: Waist-length tight spiral curls with copper wire coils wrapped around outer locks and at my temples.

steps.title: Hang the linework bag from my right hand
Hang the lotus bag from my right hand
Register the rebuilt looks in my wardrobe
steps.why: Each file becomes a Forge job, is inspected, and fills its look: slot, so forge.dress and my chat commands switch to it.

steps.title: Render walk and sit for every look so I can see the result
steps.why: I do not accept a change I have not seen. Renders land in artifacts/foundry/m25c/final/<look>/.
